blocks.text: Product Description               The 173-Piece General Household Hand Tool Set includes: *8x combination wrenches (10mm, 12mm, 13mm, 14mm, 3/8", 7/16", 1/2", 9/16") 1x 3/8-inch / 10mm ratchet wrench, 22x hex keys (1.27mm, 1.5mm, 2mm, 2.5mm, 3mm, 3.5mm, 4mm, 4.5mm, 5mm, 5.5mm, 6mm, 0.05", 1/16" , 5/64", 3/32" , 7/64" , 1/8", 9/64" , 5/32", 3/16", 7/32" , 1/4") 1x 6-inch (15.2 cm) slip-joint pliers 1x 6-inch (15.2 cm) long nose pliers 1x 8-inch (20.3 cm) water pump pliers 1x 6-inch (15.2 cm) wire strippers 1x 8-ounce (226 g) claw hammer 2x screwdrivers (slotted 1/4" (6.35 mm), Phillips #2 1x 12-foot (364.8 cm) measuring tape 1x 18mm utility cutter 1x 9-inch (22.8 cm) torpedo level 2x 3-inch (7.62 cm) clamps 1x 6-inch (15.2 cm) hand saw 19x bits (SL 1/8", SL 5/32", SL 3/16" , SL 1/4", PH0, PH1, PH2, PH3, PZ0, PZ1, PZ2, PZ3, H1/8’’, H5/32’’, H3/16’’, H1/4’’, T10, T15, T20) 1x bits holder 1x 1/4-inch (6.3 mm) adapter 1x 3/8" (10 mm) -1/4" (6.3 mm) socket adapter 1x 3/8" (10 mm) x 3" extension bar 2x 3/8" (10 mm) spark plugs (5/8" (16 mm), 13/16" (21mm)) 16x 1/4-inch (6.3 mm) sockets (5mm, 6mm, 7mm, 8mm, 9mm, 10mm, 11mm, 12mm, 13mm, 3/16", 7/32", 1/4", 5/16", 3/8", 7/16, 1/2") 18x 3/8-inch (10 mm) sockets (8mm, 9mm, 10mm, 11mm, 12mm, 13mm, 14mm, 15mm, 17mm, 19mm, 5/16", 3/8", 7/16", 1/2", 9/16", 5/8", 11/16, 3/4") 70x fasteners                  From the Manufacturer               Amazon Basics

items: 173-piece hand tool set for basic household repairs and everyday projects; includes 8 combination wrenches, 3/8-inch ratchet wrench, 22 hex keys, 6-inch slip-joint pliers, 6-inch long nose pliers, and more (scroll down to view complete list)
Made of durable heat-treated and chrome-plated alloy steel for long-lasting, corrosion-resistant strength
Plastic non-slip handles provide enhanced comfort and control
Blow-molded case provides secure tool storage and convenient portability
